authority.summary: Owner requests a point audit and minimal universal correction for a real PINK-IPTV Work execution that remained on an internal repository-compare step after required CI had already succeeded and the next physical-device Human Gate was known. This clean re-execution supersedes the pre-PR 048 attempt because exact trust-root transition authorization was not durably persisted before its trust-root edits. Scope remains limited to universal external-wait versus internal-operation liveness, Recovery routing, and the honest frozen-host limitation; no managed project is mutated.

terminal_condition: Project Leader universally distinguishes legitimate externally-backed waits from internal control-plane operations. Internal compare/diff/audit/reconciliation/read/planning steps may not be left as passive spinners: while Work remains tool-capable, two canonical liveness observations with no new tool result, durable evidence or control-state transition classify INTERNAL_OPERATION_STALLED and route through LIVENESS_RECONCILE_REQUIRED to Recovery Guardian. Recovery reconstructs durable state, immediately uses already-sufficient evidence or changes to a bounded alternate read strategy, never repeats an ambiguous write as a liveness probe, and counts repeated stalls toward the existing no-progress ceiling. Legitimate external waits remain bound to observable external state and bounded re-checks. If the host/tool call itself is frozen and cannot yield execution control, the limitation is stated honestly and the first action after control returns is reconstruction/reconciliation. Required CI and packaging alignment pass.
